--font-monospace.where: declared on `body` in app.css as `var(--font-monospace-override), var(--font-monospace-theme), var(--font-monospace-default)`; the developer docs list only the three parts, not the variable the app composes from them. Read live through the DevTools bridge on 2026-08-29 (docs/ai/reports/20260829.what-obsidian-already-provides/02.styling-theme-and-design-language.md, "Verified live").

--input-shadow.where: Declared on .theme-light and .theme-dark in app.css and used by button:not(.clickable-icon). Read from getComputedStyle(document.body) in default dark and light on 2026-09-21. The .mod-macos override sets it to none.
